what: A 100 × 60 × 10 plate a kilometre from the origin (x 1,000,000 to 1,000,100 mm), with a blind pocket 30 × 20 × 5 cut into its bottom: the modelling range's 1 km (kernel/CLAUDE.md, 'Supported modelling range'; a boolean brings both bodies near their overlap first, 35a).

recipe.do: Start a new part and delete its ready-made box (feature-1) from the timeline, as the L bracket's make does, so the counter goes on from 2. (Since 35e2 a body keeps its number for good, so the deleted box keeps Body 1 and the next bodies are Body 2 and Body 3; and each rectangle adds its four horizontal and vertical constraints, ids 11 to 14 here, so the items after it are numbered 4 later: corrected 11-06 with the step-35 models made.)
Create Sketch on the front plane XZ (sketch x is X, sketch y is Z, its normal −Y).
Extrude the sketch 60, flipped (along +Y, y 0 to 60): Body 2, the plate.
Create Sketch on the top plane XY.

Rectangle tool: click (1000020, 20), then (1000050, 40), typed (points and lines 17 to 24). Seen along Z the plate offers its corners (1,000,000 or 1,000,100, 0 or 60) and edge middles (1,000,050, 0 or 60), (1,000,000 or 1,000,100, 30), none here.
Extrude the sketch 10 (z 0 to 10): Body 3, the pocket's tool, from below the plate (its bottom is z = 5) to its middle.
Combine: target Body 2, tool Body 3, Cut, Keep tools off.

volume.why: the plate less the pocket, x 1,000,020..1,000,050, y 20..40, z 5..10 (the tool's z 0..5 is below the plate): 60000 − 3000

area.why: the plate's 15200: the pocket's floor (30 × 20 at z = 10) gives back what its mouth takes out of the bottom, and its four walls add 100 round by 5 deep

topology.why: the plate's 6 faces (its bottom with the pocket's mouth as a second loop) and the pocket's floor and 4 walls; 12 + 12 edges; 8 + 8 corners: V − E + F − (L − F) = 16 − 24 + 11 − (12 − 11) = 2

box.why: the plate's; the pocket is inside it

tolerance.why: LINEAR (10 nm) plus the kernel's stated allowance for floating-point rounding on edges a Combine makes inside faces (by design): at most 64·2⁻⁵²·max(1, 3D) past LINEAR, D the diagonal of the box round both bodies. Corrected 11-06 when the model was first made: the first expectation, exactly 1e-5, left that rounding out. Here D = √(100² + 60² + 15²) ≈ 117.6 (x 100 wide, y 0..60, z 0..15; the frame is the overlap's, so the kilometre doesn't count): ≈ 5e-12.
